QuestInfo.name: [Spiegelmann Express] The Master Explorer
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann, collector of rarities and keeper of the mustache, ventured to Slumbering Dragon Island in search of the heroes. Follow Spiegelmann to Slumbering Dragon Island.
QuestInfo.1: You survived 500 days on Slumbering Dragon Island. (Cumulative for all characters on the same world.)
QuestInfo.2: You survived for at least 500 days on Slumbering Dragon Island and received the a special title.
